name: KOSTAL PLENTICORE
userDescription: Monitors and controls KOSTAL PLENTICORE and PIKO IQ inverters through their local REST API.
_comment_variables: Defaults shipped to users. Host-specific values (addresses, credentials, serial numbers) stay empty. Every variable must match Config.COMMON or App.CONFIG; secrets use type password. tests/test_manifest.lua enforces this.

quickAppVariables.name: readValues
quickAppVariables.value: pvPower, homePower, gridPower, batteryPower, batterySoc, yieldDay

_comment_ui: Rows of elements, top to bottom. Types: label, button. Texts here are English; App.UI translates them at start. A button's events (default onReleased) call QuickApp:ui<id><Event>, e.g. uibtnRefreshOnReleased - the HC3 enforces this name on import, so it must exist in src/main.lua. The QuickApp adds one row per listed value after lblStatus (labels lblName<n> and lblValue<n>).
_comment_files: Project files in load order, after the library in src/lib/files.json. The isMain file must be last.
